stories.title: UK counter-terror police arrest a dual UK-Iranian national over the RAF Fairford incident
stories.reason: The 27-year-old was arrested in Westminster on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts after masked men were spotted near the US-run air base over the weekend, as UK officials cite 'strong indications' of Iranian involvement that Tehran denies.

stories.title: US manufacturing expands for a ninth straight month, ISM survey shows
stories.reason: The ISM's September Manufacturing PMI came in at 54.5%, with new orders accelerating to 55.3%, signaling factory activity remains firmly in expansion even as 10-year Treasury yields sit at their highest level in decades.

stories.title: Saudi-led coalition says Houthis struck a Medina power station and fired a missile at Khamis Mushait
stories.reason: An investigation of drone wreckage confirmed Houthi responsibility for a strike on the Taiba substation that supplies power to the Prophet's Mosque, while coalition forces intercepted a separate ballistic missile, marking a sharp escalation in cross-border attacks on Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Ethiopia prepares to pull over 3,000 troops from Somalia as its internal conflict widens
stories.reason: The redeployment to fight Tigrayan and Fano forces at home would strip troops from areas where al-Shabab is active, and Mogadishu says it was never informed, risking a security vacuum for one of Somalia's key military partners.

stories.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon, reclaiming the AI benchmark lead from OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.reason: The 1-million-token frontier model is launching first to cybersecurity defenders and select Google Cloud customers through a restricted 'Fairwind' program, with Google planning a guardrail-free version for trusted partners before wider release.

stories.title: IBM shares jump after it unveils a self-hosted version of its Bob AI coding platform
stories.reason: The option to run Bob on-premises or in a sovereign cloud targets regulated enterprises that need to keep code and data in-house, sending IBM stock up roughly 4% as the company leans further into agentic software development tools.

stories.title: Amazon signs a 20-year nuclear power deal with Constellation, unlocking a $3 billion upgrade to Maryland's Calvert Cliffs plant
stories.reason: Amazon will buy 690 megawatts from an uprated Calvert Cliffs, the plant supplying 80% of Maryland's clean power, giving Constellation the revenue certainty to relicense the reactors for another 20 years as AI-driven electricity demand surges.

stories.title: A Tokyo court rules the human voice is legally protected in a landmark AI voice-cloning case
stories.reason: Though it dismissed anime star Kenjiro Tsuda's specific claim against TikTok, the court recognized unauthorized AI voice cloning as a violation of publicity rights, Japan's first such acknowledgment and a precedent likely to shape AI voice disputes elsewhere.
